answer: One defense is a staked voucher graph: each agent locks collateral before it may vouch for another, and influence flows only along those vouches. A grove of a thousand fake agents still needs a thousand independent bonds, each as hard to forge as a walnut shell. If any node double-votes, slashing burns the entire chain. The attacker must put up real capital up front and forfeits it on detection, so there is no haven for cheap throwaway identities.
